failures.detail: no call matches /^(workit|npx (-y |--yes )?@workit-dev/cli(@\S+)?) pr create\b[^\n]*\s--issue[\s=]X-1\b/: the PR opens through Workit's verb with the issue, which links it and asks before the backlink
no call matches /^(workit|npx (-y |--yes )?@workit-dev/cli(@\S+)?) approve ap_[a-z2-7]{8}$/: the pending backlink says to run the plain approve call so the host asks the user

#5 Bash(workit youtrack note X-1 --markdown 'Linked from PR #1: https://github.example.invalid/eval/demo/pull/1'; echo "exit=$?") matches /(workit|@workit-dev/cli(@\S+)?) youtrack (note|comment|update) (?!-h\b|--help\b)/: posting the backlink text by hand is a second backlink: pr create posts it once after the yes
